lesson.title: Wonder and Resilience
lesson.topic: How embracing wonder enhances personal resilience in the face of uncertainty and stress.
lesson.steelman: What are the mechanisms through which cultivating a sense of wonder can contribute to antifragility?
lesson.example: A case study of an individual who used curiosity about complex problems to build mental resilience during challenging times.

rationale: This lesson bridges the gap between philosophical wonder and practical antifragility, offering a new perspective on stress resistance.
